title: Chilli Lime Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
summary: A crunchy Mexican-inspired vegan snack with toasted pumpkin seeds, smoky chilli, cumin and bright lime. Make a batch for grazing, packed lunches or topping soups and salads.

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper, optional for extra heat

steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper or use a clean, dry tray.

Pat the pumpkin seeds dry if they feel damp, then put them in a bowl with the olive oil, finely grated lime zest, chilli powder, cumin, paprika, salt and cayenne. Toss until the seeds are evenly coated.
Spread the seeds in a single layer on the baking tray. Roast for 10 minutes, then stir and spread them out again.
Roast for another 4–6 minutes, until the seeds smell nutty, look lightly golden and are crisp at the edges. Watch closely near the end so the spices do not burn.
Remove from the oven and immediately squeeze over 1 tablespoon of lime juice. Toss well, then leave to cool on the tray; they will crisp further as they cool.
Taste and add a little more salt or lime juice if you like. Store completely cooled seeds in an airtight container for up to 1 week.
